# omada_acl (Resource)

An Omada gateway, switch or EAP firewall ACL. Updates preserve fields not modelled by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "omada_acl" "home_to_iot_https" {
  type             = "gateway"
  name             = "Home to IoT HTTPS"
  policy           = "permit"
  protocols        = [6] # TCP
  source_type      = 0
  source_ids       = [omada_vlan.home.id]
  destination_type = 0
  destination_ids  = [omada_vlan.iot.id]
  lan_to_lan       = true
  lan_to_wan       = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_ids` (Set of String) Destination entity IDs.
- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `policy` (String) Rule action: permit or deny.
- `source_ids` (Set of String) Source entity IDs.

### Optional

- `destination_type` (Number) Destination entity type: 0 network, 1 IP group, or 2 port group.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the rule.
- `lan_to_lan` (Boolean) Match LAN-to-LAN traffic.
- `lan_to_wan` (Boolean) Match LAN-to-WAN traffic.
- `protocols` (Set of Number) IP protocol numbers: 1 ICMP, 6 TCP, 17 UDP, or 256 all.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID. Defaults to the provider site.
- `source_type` (Number) Source entity type: 0 network, 1 IP group, or 2 port group.
- `type` (String) ACL surface: gateway, switch, or eap.
- `vpn_in_ids` (Set of String) VPN IDs used by the direction selector.
- `wan_in_ids` (Set of String) WAN interface IDs used by the direction selector.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import IDs use site-name-or-ID:gateway|switch|eap:acl-ID.
terraform import omada_acl.home_to_iot_https 'Default:gateway:6a9ef808c7e1e2719272869b'
```
